property_summary: Invariant: calling SetMinSum(_v) on the correct contract always succeeds (no revert) only when contract is not yet initialized; the mutant removes the initialization guard so it allows setting MinSum even after Initialized() — thus for some inputs the behavior (whether SetMinSum reverts after Initialized) differs.
change_summary: Replace the body to set MinSum without the initialization check, so SetMinSum always assigns _val (removes the revert guard).
